metadata.question: Was the vegetation health (NDVI) in Namibia worse in February 21-28 2019, compared to the long-term average for the same month period from 2003 to 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need NDVI data for Namibia - Two time periods: Feb 21-28, 2019 vs. Feb 21-28 average from 2003-2017 - MODIS Terra (MOD09GA or MOD13Q1) would be good for long-term comparison - MOD13Q1 already has NDVI, 16-day composite, 250m resolution - Alternative: Sentinel-2 or Landsat with calculated NDVI 2. Masking strategy: - Use QA bands to mask clouds and poor quality pixels - For MOD13Q1, use the 'SummaryQA' band or pixel reliability band 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - NDVI ranges from -1 to 1, typically 0.2-0.8 for vegetation - Check if collection has images (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after masking (C2) - Check if mean values are valid numbers in reasonable range (C3) - Compare 2019 mean vs long-term mean: if 2019 < long-term, answer A (worse), else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const namibia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Namibia')) .geometry(); // Target period: Feb 21-28, 2019 const target_start = '2019-02-21'; const target_end = '2019-03-01'; // Long-term reference: Feb 21-28, 2003-2017 const years = ee.List.sequence(2003, 2017); // 2. Data Acquisition using MOD13Q1 (16-day NDVI product) const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .select('NDVI') .filterBounds(namibia); // Get 2019 data const target_col = modis .filterDate(target_start, target_end); const target_size = target_col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images found: ${target_size}`); if (target_size === 0) { console.log("No data for Feb 21-28, 2019"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate 2019 mean const target_mean_img = target_col.mean(); // Check pixel count const target_count = target_mean_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: namibia, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Valid pixels: ${target_count}`); if (target_count === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2019 after processing"); console.log("C2"); return; } const target_ndvi = target_mean_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: namibia, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); // Scale NDVI (MODIS NDVI is scaled by 10000) const target_ndvi_scaled = target_ndvi / 10000; console.log(`2019 NDVI: ${target_ndvi_scaled.toFixed(4)}`); // 4. Calculate long-term average (2003-2017) const long_term_list = years.map(function(year) { const y = ee.Number(year); const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 2, 21); const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 3, 1); const yearly_col = modis.filterDate(start, end); return yearly_col.mean(); }); const long_term_col = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(long_term_list); const long_term_size = long_term_col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Long-term images: ${long_term_size}`); if (long_term_size === 0) { console.log("No long-term reference data"); console.log("C1"); return; } const long_term_mean = long_term_col.mean(); const long_term_count = long_term_mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: namibia, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Long-term valid pixels: ${long_term_count}`); if (long_term_count === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for long-term average"); console.log("C2"); return; } const long_term_ndvi = long_term_mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: namibia, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const long_term_ndvi_scaled = long_term_ndvi / 10000; console.log(`Long-term NDVI (2003-2017): ${long_term_ndvi_scaled.toFixed(4)}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (target_ndvi_scaled === null || long_term_ndvi_scaled === null || isNaN(target_ndvi_scaled) || isNaN(long_term_ndvi_scaled) || target_ndvi_scaled < -1 || target_ndvi_scaled > 1 || long_term_ndvi_scaled < -1 || long_term_ndvi_scaled > 1) { console.log("Invalid NDVI values detected"); console.log("C3"); return; } const difference = target_ndvi_scaled - long_term_ndvi_scaled; console.log(`Difference (2019 - long-term): ${difference.toFixed(4)}`); if (target_ndvi_scaled < long_term_ndvi_scaled) { console.log("2019 vegetation health was WORSE than long-term average"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("2019 vegetation health was NOT worse than long-term average"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
